snippet.title: Celestial Return - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Loot, bribe, gamble, survive. The dice will be your savior or your downfall in this story-driven RPG. Every roll matters when trying to uncover cosmic horrors and outwit megacorps. Pray your next roll won’t be your last.

Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704090/Celestial_Return/

WEBSITE: https://www.celestialreturn.com/
